doc.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Leaving for New York by Christmas
summary: Liston hopes to be back in New York for Christmas and has dedicated friends there.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Right. That’s true. I have two young girls coming along that’s come to me for private things, and the main thing is to tell them what’s what, who was there, [?], and they understand. So you’re leaving us when now Melba?
I’ll be back in New York for Christmas.
I’m hoping that I’ll be back there, but I might not. I might be here for Christmas. I don’t know.
But you would like to be there for Christmas. You want all that snow and ice, right?
Yep. That’s all right with me.
You’ve got your friends back there to keep you warm. You have some dedicated friends back there, Melba. No jive. I know I’m dedicated, but you’ve got a whole big bunch of them out – back there.
